findings.entity: Man seated at counter vs counter top / front panel
findings.invariant_violated: depth ordering / impossible body placement relative to fixed counter
findings.description: In the master wide shot (00:36-00:44) the man faces the camera with the counter top in front of his torso, and his mug and plate sit on the near edge, so his upper body is on the far side of the counter. Yet his jeans and legs show in front of the counter's front panel, on the aisle side below the counter top. His body sits on both sides of the solid counter at once. It also contradicts 00:24-00:27, where he sat on an aisle-side stool facing right toward the waitress, and no stool is under him here.

findings.entity: Waitress walking from stool to back-bar vs counter
findings.invariant_violated: solid-object occlusion / passing through fixed geometry
findings.description: At 01:51 the waitress stands on the aisle side by the stools. At 01:52 her torso is behind the counter top at the back-bar coffee machine (service side), while her trailing leg shows in front of the counter's front panel on the aisle side. There is no gap or flap there. She crosses through the solid counter instead of going around its end.

findings.entity: Man's seat position in reverse angle vs master shot
findings.invariant_violated: viewpoint consistency across a reverse cut
findings.description: In the reverse from behind the service counter (00:44.958-00:51), the man sits on the far side of a short counter next to the fridges, with the stools on the opposite (near) side, and he faces this camera. In the opposing master shot just before (00:36-00:44) he also faces the camera, which looks the other way down the room. One seated man cannot face both opposite cameras. His position on the non-stool side also conflicts with the stool-side seating set up at 00:25-00:27. The counter here is a short peninsula ending at fridges and an EXIT door, not the long curved counter running to the pass-through in the master.

findings.entity: Man and waitress seated side by side (reverse two-shot)
findings.description: In the master (01:21-01:26) the waitress sits on the stool beyond the man, deeper toward the pass-through. The 01:26.792 two-shot looks back at them from across the counter. Their order along the counter should therefore put the man frame-left and the waitress frame-right. Instead the waitress is frame-left and the man frame-right, a mirrored seating order.

findings.invariant_violated: connectivity / background through openings matches established layout
findings.description: From the first interior master (00:18.708) onward, the OPEN-sign window shows a gabled building just outside, and the left windows show parked cars. The exterior establishing shot (00:00-00:10) shows the diner alone on a flat open lot with only a distant tree line and a single truck to its left. At 01:41 a side window looks onto an empty field. The view through the windows does not match the exterior that was established.
